RNA-seq.sample_type: platelet RNA isolated from platelet-rich plasma (PRP) from blood
RNA-seq.readouts: platelet transcriptome/gene expression levels over time (baseline and days 2, 7, 28 post-vaccination), including RNAs such as platelet activation, mitochondrial, and translation-related transcripts

flow cytometry.sample_type: platelets in platelet-rich plasma (PRP) from blood
flow cytometry.readouts: surface expression/percent positive for platelet activation markers CD62p, CD40L, and CD63 on CD41+CD61+ platelets

standard hemagglutination inhibition ass.readouts: influenza vaccine antibody response/HAI titers measured at day 0 and day 28
